description: Programme components (Stage 9.64B, owner ruling): the ROLE a resource plays in the member journey. They do NOT replace the Five Foundations (air, water, shelter, food, energy) — every resource keeps its foundation as well. Every resource migrated after Stage 9.64B must carry a foundation, a programme component, a category and a type, and must answer the five alignment questions, BEFORE it is rendered. If the answers are unclear the resource stops for owner review.

off-grid-living.label: Off-Grid Living
off-grid-living.definition: Resources directly supporting reduced dependence on centralised systems: independent energy, solar, batteries, generators, water capture/storage/treatment, food production, off-grid heating, fuel systems, waste systems, property/system architecture.

resilience-planning.label: Resilience Planning
resilience-planning.definition: Resources that strengthen the household and help move toward partial or full independence: insulation, heating comparisons, warm-home planning, backup power, household assessments, resilience scorecards, budgeting, phased upgrades.

resilience-emergency.label: Resilience & Emergency
resilience-emergency.definition: Resources focused on outages, emergency food, emergency water, household safety, gas leaks, smoke alarms, emergency lighting, evacuation, communication and short-term disruption.

planning-implementation.label: Planning & Implementation
planning-implementation.definition: Resources focused on budgets, project briefs, 30-day plans, 90-day plans, implementation tracking and supplier/installer planning.

advanced-future.label: Advanced / Future
advanced-future.definition: Resources for full property independence, advanced system architecture, larger integrated systems, professional implementation and advanced planning.

alignmentQuestions.foundation: Which of the Five Foundations does it support?
alignmentQuestions.programComponent: Which programme component does it belong to?
alignmentQuestions.resilienceRole: How does it support resilience, independence or off-grid living?
alignmentQuestions.guidanceKind: Is it emergency guidance, resilience planning or true off-grid system guidance?
alignmentQuestions.wordingMatchesRole: Does the member-facing wording match that role?

rulings.budgeting: If the primary output is a budget, a financial allocation, a roadmap, an action plan, an implementation schedule or a project allocation, the resource is planning-implementation. resilience-planning is used only when budgeting is a supporting element inside a broader household resilience assessment.
rulings.systemArchitecture: off-grid-living: practical entry- or intermediate-level resources that directly help a household understand, choose or establish independent systems. advanced-future: advanced, integrated, whole-property, multi-system, expert-level or later-stage architecture and planning resources. A resource is NOT moved to advanced-future merely because it is technical: basic and intermediate solar, battery, water and energy resources stay off-grid-living.

classificationsDecidedNote: OG-03 (Budget Pathway Selector): its primary output is matching a household budget to an action pathway, so the budgeting rule gives planning-implementation. Its legacy text is tied to programme tiers and prices, which the migration will have to remove. These are recorded decisions only: no live resource record has been changed. Stage 9.73 (owner, 2026-10-07): OG-08, OG-17, OG-19 off-grid-living; OG-11 resilience-emergency; OG-13 and OG-22 resilience-planning; OG-21 and OG-B10 planning-implementation. advanced-future is reserved for integrated whole-property architecture, advanced multi-system design, specialist system architecture and later-stage property/system integration; difficulty or an 'Advanced' label never makes a resource advanced-future — the primary output controls. Stage 9.73A (owner, 2026-10-07): OG-B07 CORRECTED from advanced-future to off-grid-living (an advanced single-system solar resource; difficulty alone does not make a resource advanced-future); OG-B12 stays advanced-future. The ten classifications applied in Stage 9.73 are CONFIRMED by the owner: OG-27, OG-25, OG-B04 planning-implementation; OG-18, OG-20, OG-09, OG-10, OG-B08 off-grid-living; OG-15, OG-02 resilience-planning. OG-22 resilience-planning is an explicit owner override of the general budgeting rule.

scheduledMigration.when: the next normal deployment (any deploy that is already happening for another reason)

advancedFutureRule: Stage 9.73 owner ruling: advanced-future is reserved for resources whose PRIMARY role is integrated whole-property architecture, advanced multi-system design, specialist system architecture or later-stage property/system integration. Do not classify a resource as advanced-future merely because it is difficult or labelled Advanced. Primary output still controls: an advanced implementation roadmap remains planning-implementation.
